applicabilityBasis.summary: cUSD targets dollar value and permits minting/burning at oracle value or proportional basket redemption. Those documented exits return backing digital assets and can transmit underlying depegs to redeemers. Public terms identify Covered Agents S.A. as platform operator but do not identify a legal obligor to redeem cUSD for fixed monetary value as required by GENIUS section 2(22). Stablecoin marketing and unresolved issuer/redemption rights support unclear applicability.

genius.notes: Cap documents basket-based vault redemption rather than a fixed fiat issuer redemption promise. Covered Agents S.A. of Panama operates the platform; current terms do not expressly identify it as the cUSD redemption obligor. Cap Protocol is retained as the existing protocol identity, not a verified corporate issuer. The reserve dashboard is an issuer-operated disclosure; static zero placeholders are not live reserve balances. No public monthly independent reserve attestation was found. GENIUS issuer rules remain proposed; SCRC procedural-rule effectiveness does not establish issuer qualification. No named issuer/token action was found in the regulator-domain search.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public qualifying approval, state-qualified designation, official GENIUS application or registered foreign exception was found for Cap Protocol or Covered Agents S.A. The pending OCC digital-assets table has no matching applicant; general proposed rules establish no named approval. Public searches do not exclude confidential or unindexed filings. Covered Agents is a Panama platform operator; cUSD legal issuer and fixed monetary redemption obligation remain unresolved.
